name: BAL-27 5.7x28 Assualt Rifle
teaser: Not..... Well, I don't know what it is.
description_html:
A prototype assault rifle ported from COD MW3

Includes

  • A futuristic prototype bullpup assault rifle (yes, they called it assualt rifle) that fires 5.7x28mm.
  • Barrel, stock and pistol grip modifications
  • Proprietary muzzle device and suppressor
  • Transparent magazine

Models, textures, some of the animations and audioes are properties of Actvision.

Please give clear indication of the author or origin when reuploading on other websites or publicly sharing this mod.
